cohort: 170 nulliparous women aged 18-32 years attending a higher education institution in Kathmandu, Nepal.
finding: A high prevalence of pain catastrophising was reported (55.9% at PCS>=20; 17.1% at PCS>=30), and those with higher pain catastrophising scores were significantly more likely to report painful periods affecting daily activities.
cross-section timing: At the time of survey completion
